name: b_clean_ats_url_param_not_unwrapped
why: Redirect wrappers are unwrapped only "when the URL's host is NOT a known ATS host"; lever.co is a known ATS host, so "A known ATS URL is never unwrapped, even if it has such a parameter." Also "Every other parameter is kept in its order".

name: b_clean_utm_source_uppercase_dropped
why: "Tracking parameters are dropped (name case-insensitive): utm_*, ... fbclid" and "Every other parameter is kept in its order (e.g. gh_jid, jobId, ...)"; "the scheme is lower-cased"; "When none is left there is no ?".

name: b_posting_workday_details_true
why: "Workday host: only when the path contains /job/ or /details/".

name: b_posting_workday_query_digits_false
why: Workday rule is path-only — "only when the path contains /job/ or /details/ (nothing else counts for Workday)" — and the general digit/UUID rule excludes Workday: "Any URL (including the above when their own rule did not hold, except Workday)".

name: b_posting_workable_j_code_true
why: "Workable host: path has /j/<6 or more letters/digits>" — AB12CD is 6 alphanumerics.

name: b_pick_ats_rule_d_beats_plain_apply_link
why: (b) takes the "Apply now" link, (d) takes the Greenhouse link which is "on a known ATS host AND is posting_like" (/jobs/<digits>); "Best = known ATS and posting_like, then known ATS (not posting_like), then posting_like (not ATS), then the rest".

name: b_pick_ats_board_beats_non_ats_posting
why: (c) takes the data_url whose key contains "application"; ranking is "known ATS and posting_like, then known ATS (not posting_like), then posting_like (not ATS)" — the Greenhouse board is known ATS, the company URL is only posting_like.

name: b_pick_drops_wellfound_link_and_cleans_tracking
why: "A candidate is dropped when its cleaned URL is "", is on a Wellfound host or a never-apply host"; candidates are "cleaned with clean_url" and "utm_*" is dropped, and the Workable URL is known ATS and posting_like so it is best.

name: b_classify_signin_url_in_opened
why: Rule 2: "a URL in `opened` is such a Wellfound sign-in URL" (path starts with /login).

name: b_classify_company_redirect_closed
why: Rule 3: "`url` is on a Wellfound host and its path has no /jobs/<digits> (the job page redirected elsewhere, e.g. to /jobs or /company/acme)".

name: b_classify_company_jobs_path_still_job_page
why: The path does contain /jobs/<digits>, so rule 3's URL check does not hold; pick_external is "" so rule 4 fails; rule 5: "`modal` contains "send application" ... "write a note"".

name: b_classify_signin_to_apply_text

page.text: Log in to apply to this role

why: Rule 6: "the text says "log in to apply" ... (any case)".

name: b_classify_already_applied_button
why: Rule 7: "a button label or link text starts with "Applied", "Already applied" or "You applied" (any case)".

name: b_classify_wellfound_apply_link
why: Rule 8: "a link on a Wellfound host whose text is exactly an apply label" ("Apply"); the same link is dropped from pick_external because it "is on a Wellfound host".

name: b_classify_peeked_opened_nothing
why: Rule 9: "a button whose label is exactly an apply label (reason says a peek is needed, or — when `peeked` is true — that the peek opened nothing readable)"; no opened URL, no modal text.

name: b_classify_apply_label_near_misses_unknown
why: Rule 10: "otherwise (no Apply control)" — an apply label is a whole label from the list and ""Send application" or "Submit" is not one", so "Apply filters" and "Send application" do not match; the plain company link is not a candidate ("A plain company-website link (label "acme.com", no "apply") is not a candidate unless rule (d) takes it" and acme.com is not a known ATS host).
